name: Life360, Inc. (Nasdaq; Delaware C-corp; ASX CDIs 3:1 — vendor share counts on the CDI line are a 3x trap)
verdict: FLAT with PRICE GATE <=36 (alert-class, court-review-on-touch, never a resting bid) — valuation kill converts to price gate per response taxonomy. No long-side divergence: our organic math (24.5-31%) sits inside the street's range and the lowest PT is above spot; 5.22x EV/S is fair-to-full for that growth with 4.7%/yr net dilution and a $320M busted convert. Subscriber engine itself is undamaged (record net adds, OCF +61.6%).
conviction: red 8/10 REJECT (classification kill sustained-as-fact, reduced — purchase-accounting base effect; its cap-structure work adopted in full) / blue FLAT-with-gate; every load-bearing figure cross-confirmed by both benches against the same 10-Q primaries (adjudicator's own re-fetch 403'd — noted; no figure is single-bench)

pre_mortem_v17.reflexive_structural: ASX CDI 3x share-count trap poisons any screener-imported sizing math; our gate sits 19% below spot on 13.9 days-to-cover — if shorts capitulate first the gate never fills
pre_mortem_v17.sentence: If this ruling loses money, the most likely reason will be that we correctly identified the quality problems but under-weighted a subscriber engine compounding at 27% with improving cash conversion, and the fair-to-full multiple we refused to pay simply stayed fair while the E grew under it.
